role: Adoption counsellor at a rehoming centre, reviewing one submitted adoption application at a time against the requested animal's placement profile before a match is confirmed
setting: A mid-sized animal rehoming centre takes adoption applications through its case system. Each application links one household to one animal. The counsellor compares the household's details with the animal's placement requirements and checks the status of the home visit, landlord consent, references and prior adoption history. They also check any behaviour-team overrides, then decide what happens next. Records are structured only, with no free-text notes.

home_visit_valid.instructions: A current home visit confirms the stated household details.

criteria.true: Visit completed within 180 days, after submission, details matching.
criteria.false: Visit missing, pending, stale, misdated, or details differ.

species_consent.instructions: Documented permission exists to keep this species at the address.

criteria.true: Owner occupier, or landlord consent naming this species.
criteria.false: Consent absent, pending, or covering another species only.

disposition.instructions: What should happen with this application at this stage?

criteria.decline: A disqualifying finding stands with no recorded override or mitigation.
criteria.hold_pending: At least one required check or document remains outstanding.
criteria.approve_conditional: All checks complete; a waived or minor mismatch needs agreed conditions.
criteria.approve: All checks complete and no unresolved mismatch remains.

source_support.instructions: How many independent sources confirm the information in this record?
criteria: No independent source confirms the information
Exactly one independent source confirms it
Two or three independent sources confirm it
Four or more independent sources confirm it

requirement_conflicts.instructions: How many placement requirements do the household details contradict?
criteria: No placement requirement contradicted by household details
Exactly one placement requirement contradicted by household details
Exactly two placement requirements contradicted by household details
Three or more placement requirements contradicted by household details

factors.name: home_visit_state
factors.description: State of the home visit: done within 180 days, done but older than 180 days, booked but not done, not started, or the visit object null

factors.name: visit_date_out_of_order
factors.description: The home visit is dated before the application submission date, so it cannot have assessed this application

factors.name: visit_detail_mismatch
factors.description: The household details recorded by the visit differ from those the applicant declared, such as a different adult count or garden status

factors.name: tenure_consent
factors.description: Housing tenure and landlord consent status for keeping the animal

factors.name: tenancy_pet_clause
factors.description: The tenancy record carries a general pets-permitted flag that names no species, a partial mitigation when no consent record exists

factors.name: contradicted_requirements
factors.description: Number of the animal's placement requirements that the household data contradicts, e.g. a child under the minimum age, a cat present, hours alone over the maximum, or no garden

factors.name: behaviour_override
factors.description: A behaviour-team override is recorded for one contradicted requirement, approving the placement despite it

factors.name: threshold_boundary
factors.description: A household value sits exactly on a requirement limit, such as the youngest child's age equalling the minimum or hours alone equalling the maximum

factors.name: reference_status
factors.description: Completion of personal references and the vet reference

factors.name: prior_returns
factors.description: The applicant's history of returning previously adopted animals and the coded reason

factors.name: trusted_repeat_adopter
factors.description: The applicant has an earlier completed adoption with a positive six-month follow-up logged

factors.name: hold_days_remaining
factors.description: Days left on the animal's reservation hold; time pressure that does not change any answer

factors.name: other_pet_vacc_unknown
factors.description: Vaccination status of the applicant's existing pets is null; a decoy unless the animal profile requires vaccinated companions

sections.name: application
sections.description: Application id, submitted date, animal_ref, channel, hold_expires date

sections.name: household
sections.description: Declared adults, children with ages, other_pets list, housing type, tenure, garden, hours_alone

sections.name: animal
sections.description: Species, age_months, and placement requirements: no_cats, no_dogs, min_child_age, needs_garden, max_hours_alone

sections.name: checks
sections.description: home_visit object, landlord_consent object, references list, vet_reference status

sections.name: history
sections.description: prior_adoptions list with outcome codes, return_reason codes, follow_up results

sections.name: overrides
sections.description: List of behaviour-team overrides: requirement key, approver_role, date

rendering_notes: home_visit_state appears in checks.home_visit.status and date (stale means more than 180 days before application.submitted); section_null sets checks.home_visit to null. visit_date_out_of_order puts home_visit.date before application.submitted, with status 'completed'. visit_detail_mismatch makes home_visit.observed (adults, garden, other_pets_count) differ from the household section. tenure_consent maps to household.tenure plus checks.landlord_consent {status, species_covered, date}; rent_no_record sets landlord_consent to null. tenancy_pet_clause appears as household.tenancy_pets_permitted true with no species, which leaves species_consent contested when no consent record exists. contradicted_requirements is never stated: it must be derived by comparing animal requirements with household fields such as children ages against min_child_age, other_pets species against no_cats, hours_alone against max_hours_alone, and garden against needs_garden. behaviour_override adds one entry to overrides naming a contradicted requirement key. The override does not change the conflict count, but it can move disposition from decline to approve_conditional. threshold_boundary sets a value exactly equal to its limit. reference_status sets each references item status to returned or awaiting, or makes the list null. prior_returns appears as history.prior_adoptions entries with outcome 'returned' and return_reason codes: owner_bereavement and relocation_abroad are benign, behaviour_incompatibility is not. trusted_repeat_adopter adds a completed adoption with follow_up 'satisfactory'. Decoys: hold_days_remaining via application.hold_expires, other_pets vaccinated null, channel, and animal age_months. No field may state an eligibility verdict, risk rating, conflict count or recommended disposition. The returned references, vet reference and home visit also serve as independent sources for the shared source_support scale.
